I'm getting these warnings too. I think from the other comments that this is a Quarkus thing, and not a me thing. Is that right?

> I'm getting these warnings too. I think from the other comments that this is a Quarkus thing, and not a me thing. Is that right?

Yes. Specifically, the `quarkus-kafka-streams` extension declares invalid `@Startup` methods here: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/extensions/kafka-streams/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/kafka/streams/runtime/KafkaStreamsProducer.java#L119-L133. As I explained in the comment above - a regular `StartupEvent` observer is needed instead.

CC @ozangunalp @alesj

issue.title: Kafka Streams fire event after created and before scheduling the start
issue.body:
Schedules the KafkaStreams#start at StartupEvent instead of PostConstruct.
Removes Startup annotation from producer methods.

Fixes #36341 and #36774

Corrects Kafka streams default Kafka broker to localhost:9092 instead of 9012.

Switching StartupEvent I haven't noticed any change in registered classes for native compilation
